error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Birdfy API. Check your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: This Birdfy account is already configured.

init.title: Bird identification
init.description: Choose an AI Task entity to identify the birds in each new clip. Each analysis is billed by your AI provider. Leave empty to disable identification.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Add an AI provider under Settings > Devices & services to see it here. It must support attachments.
data_description.max_daily_analyses: Protects against unexpected costs, for example on a windy day. Clips over the limit are skipped.

ai_not_configured.message: Choose an AI Task entity in the Birdfy options first.

backfill_running.message: An analysis of past clips is already running.

unknown_species.message: The species {species} is not in the list.

cloud_error.message: The Birdfy cloud could not be reached: {error}

ffmpeg_not_found.message: ffmpeg was not found on the Home Assistant host.

ai_task_entity_missing.title: The Birdfy AI Task entity is missing
ai_task_entity_missing.description: {entity_id} does not exist, so new clips are not analyzed. Choose another entity in the Birdfy options, or restore the AI provider integration.

download_thumbnails.name: Download thumbnails
download_thumbnails.description: Download Birdfy event thumbnails to a local or network path (delta mode — skips already downloaded files).

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to fetch (max 30, default 1 = today only).

share.name: Network share
share.description: Name of the network share mounted in HA under /media/ (e.g. "my_nas"). Takes priority over path if set.

path.name: Custom path
path.description: Full path where thumbnails will be saved. Used only if share is not set.

download_videos.name: Download videos
download_videos.description: Download Birdfy event videos (MP4) to a local or network path (delta mode — skips already downloaded files).

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to fetch (default 1 = today only).

share.name: Network share
share.description: Name of the network share mounted in HA under /media/ (e.g. "my_nas"). Takes priority over path if set.

path.name: Custom path
path.description: Full path where videos will be saved. Used only if share is not set.

analyze_events.name: Analyze past clips
analyze_events.description: Identify the birds in past clips, in the background. Clips already analyzed are skipped. Each analysis is billed by your AI provider.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to analyze (max 30, default 1 = today only).

remove_species.name: Remove a species
remove_species.description: Remove a species added by mistake from the list of species seen.

species.name: Species
species.description: Common or scientific name of the species.
